The '''Ab'Bshingh system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Sujimis sector/Legends|Sujimis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] containing the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ab'Bshingh]].
